title: Audits on Social Enterprises Managing Hawker Centres to Prevent Charging of Hidden Fees
what_it_is: Audits on Social Enterprises Managing Hawker Centres to Prevent Charging of Hidden Fees

sections.label: NEA appoints not-for-profit operators
sections.summary: NEA began appointing socially conscious operators to run new hawker centres on a not-for-profit basis in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) started appointing socially conscious operators to manage new hawker centres on a not-for-profit basis in 2015.

sections.label: Economical meal options in centres
sections.summary: Almost every stall in the new hawker centres offers at least one economical meal priced at $3 or less.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Almost every stall in the new hawker centres offers at least one economical meal option, priced at $3 or less.

sections.label: Hawkers benefiting from programme
sections.summary: Sixteen hawkers have benefited from this programme to date.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Sixteen hawkers have benefited from this programme to date.

sections.label: Tender criterion on rental costs
sections.summary: One key tender evaluation criterion is the rental and operating costs operators will charge stallholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: One key tender evaluation criterion when evaluating bids from potential operators is the rental and operating costs that the operators will charge stallholders.

sections.label: New charges need NEA approval
sections.summary: Any new charges, including optional charges for value-added services, are subject to NEA's approval.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Any new charges, including optional charges for value-added services offered by the operators, are subject to NEA's approval.

sections.label: Ci Yuan optional charge uptake
sections.summary: The $600 at Hougang Ci Yuan was optional, and only nine non-EP stallholders took up this optional charge.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: If the Member is referring to, for instance, the Hougang Ci Yuan hawker centre managed by Fei Siong, that $600 was an optional cost and not a mandatory charge.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And if there are optional charges or any new initiatives that would impact costs, they are required to inform us and to get our approval.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, of the 40-odd stallholders in Ci Yuan hawker centre, for instance, only nine of the non-EP stallholders have taken up this optional charge.

sections.label: No subsidies for new centres
sections.summary: There are no plans to offer subsidies because operators came in knowing the costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: At this point in time, we have no plans to offer any subsidies because they actually came in knowing what the costs are.

sections.label: Turnover at new centres
sections.summary: The turnover or vacancy rate for new centres is comparable to existing centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, the turnover or the vacancy rate for these new centres are actually quite comparable to our existing centres.

sections.label: Ci Yuan tenancy renewed
sections.summary: Ci Yuan renewed its tenancy agreement because it met key performance indicators on food variety, meals, vibrancy and productivity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As far as we are concerned, Ci Yuan, for instance, had actually renewed their tenancy agreement with us, because they have actually met our key performance indicators: they have been able to provide a good variety of affordable food to residents, ensure that the hawker centre is able to provide meals at all times of the day, they were able to enhance the vibrancy of the hawker centres and also implement productivity initiatives.
